Operations Manager Job at BMHR Consulting Limited




        
    

        
        BMHR Consulting Limited - Our client, a fast-growing luxury beauty and aesthetics clinic is recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Operations Manager
Job Location: Lekki Phase 1, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	They are looking for an exceptional Operations Manager to oversee the day-to-day running of the business, improve efficiency, drive team performance, and ensure an outstanding client experience.
	This is a leadership role for someone who is highly organised, proactive, results-driven, and passionate about excellence.


Key Responsibilities
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Oversee the daily operations of the clinic.
	Ensure excellent customer service and client satisfaction.
	Monitor staff performance, attendance, punctuality, and productivity.
	Implement and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs).


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Management, Healthcare Management, or a related field with 3 – 5 years’ experience in an Operations Manager or similar leadership role.
	Experience in the beauty, wellness, healthcare, or hospitality
	Preferably a female


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Operations Manager" as the subject of the email.

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Brand & Marketing Manager",
  "description": "Jobtion Consulting - Our client, a fast-growing organisation in the food and beverage distribution sector is recruiting an experienced candidates to fill the position below:

Job Position: Brand &amp; Marketing Manager

Job Location: Isolo, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: CEO/MD

Job Summary


	The Brand &amp; Marketing Manager will be responsible for developing and executing brand and marketing strategies that drive brand awareness, consumer engagement, market penetration, sales growth and brand profitability.
	The role will oversee assigned brands from strategy and positioning through campaign execution, trade marketing, activations, digital marketing and performance analysis. The successful candidate will work closely with Sales, Finance and Operations to ensure marketing activities translate into measurable commercial results.
	We are looking for a commercially minded marketer with strong brand management experience, creative thinking and the ability to move seamlessly from strategy to execution.

        Jobtion Consulting - Our client, a fast-growing organisation in the food and beverage distribution sector is recruiting an experienced candidates to fill the position below:

Job Position: Brand & Marketing Manager

Job Location: Isolo, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: CEO/MD

Job Summary
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	The Brand & Marketing Manager will be responsible for developing and executing brand and marketing strategies that drive brand awareness, consumer engagement, market penetration, sales growth and brand profitability.
	The role will oversee assigned brands from strategy and positioning through campaign execution, trade marketing, activations, digital marketing and performance analysis. The successful candidate will work closely with Sales, Finance and Operations to ensure marketing activities translate into measurable commercial results.
	We are looking for a commercially minded marketer with strong brand management experience, creative thinking and the ability to move seamlessly from strategy to execution.


Responsibilities


	Develop and execute annual brand and marketing strategies aligned with commercial objectives.
	Manage assigned brands, including positioning, consumer strategy, brand growth and market expansion.
	Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital, traditional media, events, activations and trade channels.
	Drive trade marketing initiatives that support sales volume, value, distribution and brand visibility.
	Develop on-trade and off-trade activation programmes across relevant outlets and channels.
	Oversee digital marketing, social media and relevant influencer/partnership initiatives.
	Conduct market, consumer and competitor analysis to identify growth opportunities and threats.
	Manage marketing budgets and evaluate campaign effectiveness and return on marketing investment.
	Work closely with Sales, distributors and key accounts to translate brand strategy into commercial initiatives.
	Manage agencies, vendors and other marketing partners to ensure quality and timely delivery.
	Track brand performance, campaign results, market penetration, visibility and other agreed KPIs.
	Provide management with actionable insights and recommendations based on brand and market performance.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication, Advertising or a related field.
	Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in brand management, marketing, trade marketing or FMCG.
	CIM or equivalent professional marketing qualification is an advantage.
	MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is an added advantage.
	Strong experience in Wine & Spirits, FMCG, Beverages, Hospitality, Consumer Goods or related sectors is highly desirable.
	Proven experience managing brands and marketing campaigns from strategy through execution.
	Experience working with Sales teams, distributors, agencies and trade partners.
	Strong understanding of the Nigerian consumer and trade environment.
	Experience managing marketing budgets and measuring campaign performance/ROI.
	Strong commercial orientation, analytical ability, creativity and execution skills.


Salary
N1,000,000 – N1,500,000 gross monthly
